en.title: Nvidia–Lancium power investment ties AI capital directly to energy infrastructure
en.coreFact: A leading AI chip company has made an investment in Lancium, a power-focused data infrastructure developer, indicating a direct financial link between AI compute demand and electricity supply.
en.whyItMatters: AI capital is no longer only buying electricity through market or utility arrangements; it is now taking ownership positions in power infrastructure. This shifts how datacenters, grids, and capital flows interact.
